**Beta build.** Installs as a normal update over your existing LG Remote app (same app, same settings, same pairing). When the beta is good it becomes the next stable release.

### What's new in this beta
- **Direct connection**: the app remembers each TV's address and checks it directly, instead of waiting for a network search to find the TV. The TV should show up and connect right away after opening the app, and after Wake-on-LAN.
- The TV's IP address can be viewed and edited in the TV's Edit screen. It is learned automatically the first time the TV is found.
